blocks.text: define bubble style [STYLE] using text style [TEXT_STYLE]
blocks.description: Defines or replaces a bubble style and references a named SVG Text style.

blocks.text: set bubble placement [PLACEMENT] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets an actor-relative direction/angle or a background-relative region. Direction aliases and Scratch-style degrees from 0 through 360 are accepted.

blocks.text: set portrait base [ASSET] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the registered image asset used as the portrait base. An empty asset removes the complete portrait.

blocks.text: set bubble distance [DISTANCE] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the distance from the actor bounds to the tail tip for actor-relative placement.

blocks.text: set bubble visual style [VISUAL_STYLE] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the SVG body shape used by this bubble style.

blocks.text: set bubble tail length [LENGTH] for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets the nominal length from the bubble border to the tail tip for actor-relative placement.

blocks.text: set bubble offset x [X] y [Y] scale [SCALE] % for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Offsets and scales the bubble body while keeping scale-only actor distance constant.

blocks.text: set blink frames [ASSETS] every [SECONDS] seconds for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets comma-separated registered image assets for the portrait blink layer. An empty list removes blink animation.

blocks.text: set talk frames [ASSETS] every [SECONDS] seconds for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets comma-separated registered image assets for the portrait talk layer. An empty list removes talk animation.

blocks.text: set advance frames [ASSETS] every [SECONDS] seconds for bubble style [STYLE]
blocks.description: Sets at least two comma-separated registered image assets for the awaiting-advance indicator. An empty list removes the indicator.
Shows or replaces this sprite's layered say bubble in talking animation mode.
Shows or replaces this sprite's layered think bubble in talking animation mode.
Changes this sprite's bubble animation mode. Awaiting advance stops talk animation and starts the configured advance frames.

blocks.text: wait with this bubble until condition [CONDITION] or timeout after [TIMEOUT] seconds
blocks.description: Switches to awaiting-advance mode, evaluates a Runtime Expression condition using variables updated by Async Input, and waits until the condition is true or the timeout expires. Zero disables the timeout.
Closes this sprite's bubble and releases its timers, SVG text skin, and drawables.
